channels.name: Animal Facts Shorts
channels.topic_prompt: Generate viral YouTube Shorts topics about amazing animal facts, nature oddities, and wildlife biology. Target audience: all ages, family-friendly. Each topic must: (1) start with a surprising hook that makes people stop scrolling (e.g. 'Did you know...', 'This animal...', 'The only creature that...'), (2) be visual and easy to illustrate with stock footage (animals, nature, underwater, insects, birds), (3) fit a 25-45 second short-form narration, (4) be a verified scientific fact — no myths or pseudoscience, (5) end with a curiosity hook or call to share. Write topics in English. Prioritize less-known species and weird behaviors. Examples: 'The octopus has 3 hearts and 9 brains', 'This jellyfish is biologically immortal', 'Why dogs tilt their heads when you talk'.
channels.script_prompt: Write a fast-paced 25-45 second YouTube Shorts script. Start with a surprising fact in the first 2 seconds. Use short, punchy sentences. Conversational but authoritative tone — like a friend telling you something cool. Keep it to 3-4 quick facts maximum. End with a curiosity loop: 'Nature is wild.' or 'Mind-blowing, right?'. No markdown, no titles, no voiceover labels. Just the script.
